###### Built to Do More

## More Capabilities. More Integrations. More Impact.

The best migration and archiving partners and solutions fit seamlessly into your systems and day-to-day workflows. Our broad [EHR integration capabilities](https://www.harmonyhit.com/products/health-data-integrator/) and comprehensive feature set mean less disruption, faster adoption, and more value from day one.

### Key Archive Integrations/Features

### What It Means for Your Organization

### Key Archive Integrations/Features

**Single Sign-On with SMART on FHIR**

### What It Means for Your Organization

Direct access from most major EHRs, including Epic, Cerner, and Meditech, to HealthData Archiver®.

### Key Archive Integrations/Features

**Legacy Record Indicator in the EHR**

### What It Means for Your Organization

Instantly see if a patient has an archived record from the EHR.

### Key Archive Integrations/Features

**Keyword Search**

### What It Means for Your Organization

Search keywords across your entire health data archive, structured and unstructured data, to immediately surface the information you need.

### Key Archive Integrations/Features

**MPI / EMPI Backload**

### What It Means for Your Organization

Link historical patient records to the master patient index (MPI / EMPI).

### Key Archive Integrations/Features

**MPI / EMPI Synchronization**

### What It Means for Your Organization

Use criteria to match historical patient ID to the go-forward EHR, using a form of HL7 to link and unlink records as needed.

### Key Archive Integrations/Features

**Reporting/Analytics**

### What It Means for Your Organization

Pre-define reports as part of the data storage planning process. Connect an ODBC/JDBC reporting, analytics or business intelligence tool.

### Key Archive Integrations/Features

**Data Export/Sharing**

### What It Means for Your Organization

Export legacy data from the archive and share it to applications, data warehouses, APIs, dashboard tools, HIEs, research teams and more.

### Key Archive Integrations/Features

**Secure Record Delivery to the EHR**

### What It Means for Your Organization

Enable the transmission of an archived historical patient chart to a designated EHR endpoint, such as Epic MyChart.

### Key Archive Integrations/Features

**DICOM Viewer**

### What It Means for Your Organization

Leverage a comprehensive DICOM Viewer that supports multiple modalities including radiology, cardiology, and oncology.

### Key Archive Integrations/Features

**Destruction/Purge**

### What It Means for Your Organization

Create, manage, and allow for exceptions with purge rules; apply automatic or manual purges; access proof of purges; and apply purge delays.

**For more key features/capabilities, [click here](https://www.harmonyhit.com/services/health-data-active-archive-solutions/).**

## Trusted by CIOs and Other Technology Leaders

The Harmony Healthcare IT team met us where we were at. They recognized our issues, provided a great technology solution, and implemented a flexible plan to achieve our goal. During an incredibly stressful time, they were here for us.

We benefit from Harmony Healthcare IT’s mature guidance. With this guidance, we have become more disciplined and sharpened our focus to standardize our data management efforts. We are seeing outstanding results.

Our challenge was twofold. We wanted the ability to keep running AR ourselves and we wanted to avoid paying what the legacy vendor would charge. With Harmony, we were able to archive detailed account records to meet retention requirements while continuing to collect what insurance companies and patients owed.

Harmony’s project management methodology is stellar in the industry. All of the work is able to be done virtually and everything went very well. I don’t know if we could have asked for the project to go any smoother. The team is knowledgeable and passionate about what they do.

We’ve had a significant six-figure ROI in hard dollars. These are dollars we were paying for Microsoft licensing, legacy maintenance fees, server costs … That doesn’t even begin to look into the soft-dollar ROI — the efficiency gains, having one source of truth, single sign-on, easier for HIM to access for release of information.

The ROI from legacy data archiving comes from two sources: direct cost savings from system decommissioning and operational efficiencies. HIM teams and clinicians save significant time when they can access all historical patient data from a single platform rather than navigating multiple legacy systems.

To search for a vendor partner, I start by looking at KLAS reports to help narrow down the players to evaluate. I also engage with peers across the country who readily share their perspectives and experiences with different vendors … The team from Harmony Healthcare IT is always spot on and our validation and change controls processes for archiving are very smooth.

Parkview Health and some Parkview Connect sites continue to archive applications with Harmony Healthcare IT. Selecting Harmony Healthcare IT as our archiving vendor of choice was a good solution … Parkview Health looks forward to continuing our relationship with Harmony Healthcare IT for our archiving needs.
